notes.title: Cut Scenes added and some fixes
notes.notes: Hi everyone! We have added two important cut scenes to help flesh out the story. Some fixes were done too. With two months into the launch of LiLy's Revenge: Broken  - Chapter 0, half of the players had trouble getting past the first barrier. Because of that, we've decided to added a little hint in game. Hopefully it helps and encourages players to not give up in the beginning. Let me know what you think? ^__^
